answer: Proposal 'nullifier': a licensed issuer blind-signs one credential per verified person after a document check; each epoch the wallet derives that epoch's nullifier from the credential, and the ledger rejects any second entry bearing the same nullifier. Minting fresh keys costs less than reeds on a river bank, but keys are not credentials, so an alias swarm casts one zephyr of a vote. Assumption: the issuer enforces one-per-person honestly, rationing enrollment like an ivory carver rations tusks; a bribed issuer is the open hole no ledger rule repairs.
